title: Zorro Ranch breeding program claims
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Zorro Ranch breeding program claims, about 2000s at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they claim that they were taken to Zoro Ranch specifically as part of a breeding program where Epstein intended to inseminate them with fetuses that had superior genetics.

plain: A philosopher, Jason Jorjani, told podcast host Jesse Michels about claims he wrote up in an online newsletter piece about Ghislaine Maxwell, a close associate of the financier Jeffrey Epstein. Jorjani says that some women claim they were taken in the 2000s to Zorro Ranch, Epstein's property in New Mexico, as part of a breeding program. According to these claims, Epstein meant to make them pregnant with children of supposedly superior genetics.
